description: Saves up to 12 candidates from search_candidates as a private Hire Overseas shortlist page and returns its link (shortlistUrl) for the user to share with colleagues. Each person who opens it confirms their own work email first. Every candidate is checked again now; ones no longer available are left out and counted in droppedCount. The link works for 60 days. Requires the user's lead_token.

candidate_refs.description: candidateRef values from search_candidates, in the order to show them

lead_token.description: The leadToken from verify_email. Required: shortlists and saved searches belong to the user's verified work email.

note.description: Optional short note shown on the page, e.g. what the user liked about them

title.description: What the list is for, e.g. 'Bookkeeper shortlist for the finance team'

name: create_shortlist
title: Share a shortlist of candidates
